title: A Counterexample to Kaplansky's Direct-Finiteness Conjecture in Odd Characteristic

abstractEnglish: We construct a counterexample to Kaplansky's direct-finiteness conjecture in odd characteristic. For one specified odd prime p, we obtain a field K of order p4, a finitely generated group G containing torsion, and finite sums $`a,b\in K[G]`$ with $`ab=1`$ but $`ba\ne1`$. The same elements define a cellular automaton on KG that is injective but not surjective.
titleEn: A Counterexample to Kaplansky's Direct-Finiteness Conjecture in Odd Characteristic
titleZh: 奇数特征下Kaplansky直接有限性猜想的一个反例

details.overview: 稿件在奇数特征下构造Kaplansky直接有限性猜想的反例：对某个指定奇素数p，得到阶为p^4的域K、含挠元的有限生成群G，以及K[G]中有限和a、b满足ab=1但ba≠1；同样元素定义KG上一个单射不满射的元胞自动机。作者据此声称在奇数特征下否定该猜想，联系群环的单位性质与元胞自动机的可逆性。
